department: Scheduled Castes Development Department / Scheduled Tribes Development Department / Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala
description: e-Grantz is the Government of Kerala's centralized online system for disbursing post-matric educational assistance (fee concession and maintenance allowance) to SC, ST, OBC and OEC (Other Eligible Community) students through a single registration on the e-Grantz 3.0 portal.

eligibility.education_level: Post-Matric: Higher Secondary/VHSE (Class 11-12), Polytechnic, Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Professional and Doctoral courses
eligibility.course_type: General, Technical, Professional and Vocational courses approved by the concerned University or Board
eligibility.year_of_study: Any year of a post-matric course (renewable annually)
eligibility.institution_type: Government, Government-aided and recognized institutions within Kerala; select institutions outside Kerala also covered under specific components
eligibility.income_limit: No income limit for SC, ST and OEC students; annual family income below ₹1,00,000 for OBC students
eligibility.domicile: Applicant or parent/guardian must be a permanent resident of Kerala
eligibility.attendance_requirement: Minimum 75% monthly attendance required to remain eligible
other_conditions: Student must not simultaneously avail more than one scholarship/stipend
Must be a regular student pursuing a post-matric course recognized by the University/Board

benefits.tuition_fee_support: Reimbursement of tuition and special fees as per the approved fee structure of the course/institution
benefits.maintenance_allowance: Monthly stipend, reported to range from approximately ₹100 to ₹1,500 depending on course level and category
benefits.laptop_or_device_support: Free Laptop Scheme component available for SC/ST students pursuing professional or postgraduate courses (exact grant amount not published on official sources reviewed)

application.application_mode: Online, with a signed printout submitted to the institution for verification
application_steps: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on egrantz.kerala.gov.in using Aadhaar
Log in and complete the student profile (personal, academic and bank details)
Print the submitted application and hand it over to the institution/college office along with supporting documents

target_students: SC, ST, OBC and OEC students in Kerala pursuing post-matric education
ai_metadata.searchable_text: e-Grantz Post-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST, OBC and OEC students of Kerala studying from Class 11 up to postgraduate and professional courses, providing tuition fee concession and monthly maintenance allowance via the e-Grantz 3.0 portal.

ministry: Ministry of Education, Government of India (Centrally Sponsored Scheme)
department: State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT), Kerala
description: NMMS is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme launched to award scholarships to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest their dropout at Class VIII and encourage them to continue education through the secondary and higher secondary stages. In Kerala, the selection examination is conducted by SCERT Kerala.

eligibility.education_level: Class 8 (at time of the qualifying exam); scholarship continues through Class 9 to Class 12
eligibility.course_type: General secondary and higher secondary education
eligibility.year_of_study: Class 8 for the entrance exam; renewed annually through Class 12
eligibility.institution_type: Government and Government-aided schools under Government of Kerala only
eligibility.income_limit: Parental/family annual income not exceeding ₹3,50,000 from all sources
eligibility.domicile: Studying in a Government or Government-aided school in Kerala
eligibility.academic_percentage: Minimum 55% marks in Class 7 final examination (50% for SC/ST students)
other_conditions: Not eligible if studying in Kendriya Vidyalaya, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Sainik School, private schools, or residential/adopted schools under the state government
Selection is based on performance in the Mental Ability Test (MAT) and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT)
Must maintain satisfactory academic performance each year for scholarship renewal

benefits.maintenance_allowance: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month), disbursed directly to the student's bank account

application.application_mode: Online registration for the exam via nmmse.kerala.gov.in; written examination conducted offline at designated centers
application_steps: Register/log in via Candidate Login on nmmse.kerala.gov.in
Fill in personal and school details
Appear for the NMMS examination (MAT and SAT)
Check results/merit list on the official portal

target_students: Class 8 students from economically weaker families studying in Government/Government-aided schools in Kerala
ai_metadata.searchable_text: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) for Class 8 students of Government and Government-aided schools in Kerala with family income below ₹3.5 lakh, providing ₹12,000 per year to continue education through Class 12, administered by SCERT Kerala.

department: Department of Social Justice / Kerala Social Security Mission (KSSM)
description: Snehapoorvam is a welfare scheme implemented through the Kerala Social Security Mission (Department of Social Justice) that provides monthly financial assistance to children who have lost one or both parents, to help prevent school/college dropout due to financial hardship.

eligibility.education_level: Class 1 to Degree/Professional courses (a separate child-welfare component covers children below 5 years)
eligibility.course_type: General school education, ITI, Polytechnic/Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation
eligibility.institution_type: Government, Government-aided and recognized private institutions in Kerala
eligibility.income_limit: Below Poverty Line (BPL) families are eligible; for Above Poverty Line (APL) families, annual income must be below ₹20,000 in rural areas and ₹22,375 in urban areas
other_conditions: Applicant must have lost one or both parents
Application must be submitted through the school/college where the student is currently studying
Institution verifies and forwards the application via the E-Suraksha portal to KSSM for approval and disbursal

benefits.maintenance_allowance: Monthly financial assistance: ₹300 (Class 1-5), ₹500 (Class 6-10), ₹750 (Class 11-12), ₹1,000 (Degree/Professional courses); paid for a maximum of 10 months in an academic year

application.application_mode: Offline application submitted through the school/college; institution enters/verifies details via the E-Suraksha portal (kssm.ikm.in)
application_steps: Obtain the application form from the school/college
Attach required documents (death certificate, income proof, Aadhaar)
Submit the completed application to the school/college head
Institution verifies and submits the application via the E-Suraksha portal
Application is forwarded to KSSM for approval and disbursal

target_students: Orphaned or single-parent children in Kerala from BPL or low-income families
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Snehapoorvam Scholarship by Kerala Social Security Mission provides monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹300 to ₹1,000 to children who have lost one or both parents, studying from Class 1 to degree/professional courses in Kerala.
